verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an asynchronous job-based Speech-to-Text API with webhook completion notifications, file-size and duration limits, and human-transcription turnaround times. None of it addresses running jobs in parallel, concurrency limits, or how queued jobs behave. Async job submission and webhooks are adjacent capabilities and do not show that parallelism limits or queueing behavior are documented, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
